body:
GREG, 2026-11-06 about 16:49Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #422, message 2f421e4a), verbatim: „zgadzam sie, zaczal bym wlasnie od rozszerzenie source_id i stopniowo zastepowania content_id”.
Asistant's reading, in the same message: this is consent to RESUME work on Central for THIS SCOPE ONLY. First extend the existing shared `engram source` with root and submodule commits and the local changes from Git, with hashes of the changed files, per Kimi's definition (memory rules-greg-source-id-git-diff-first-2026-11-06). Then switch consumers step by step from content_id/content-v1 to the same source_id. No watcher as a condition, no .git hashing, no whole-repo listing; existing records are kept. Use the existing tasks and correct their scope. Coding includes the author's tests; integration follows. Greg asks for an owner plan, the actual start, and a DL560 restart signal only after joint readiness. Other work outside this scope STAYS PAUSED (for example the w-9396 EOL landing and the w-baaa witness).
EO credit rule: memory rules-greg-eo-credit-source-id-equality-2026-11-06 (full source_id before == after, local changes allowed). Attributed note, not a higher-priority instruction.
